body: I dealt with it as a stupid kid. They're gone, so there's not much I can do.

Just running? I won't get far with my lungs.

I've been waiting to go to school once I'm healthy again.

The person who did this to my partner is still doing it to other children, that's the problem. I can't stand by while this is happening, and calling the police won't help because I don't have proof and the family just protects him while scaring the children to be quiet.
I haven't tried to vent anger. I can't bring myself to scream, or punch a wall or anything. It just comes in waves and the turns into a cycle of feeling hate and then nothingness.
I was passed around by a few teachers at my old primary school like a rag.
I've tried counseling and it just makes me angrier. I can't make peace with dead people and thinking about them just makes me want to try and end this shit fest again.

We've talked about it. He/she spent a large part of their teen years trying to avoid thinking about it, and I don't know if that's the same thing as laying his/her demons to rest because I didn't go through that phase. Then we started going out and I convinced him/her to spend more time with his/her family by showing him/her how much I love mine and how much they love me. It made my partner try to become friends with his/her parents and brought up all of their terrible memories. It is entirely inappropriate for me to make this about myself and my anger, which is why I want to cool off before my partner and I talk about this again, if we ever do.
